_comment: The one glossary of the screens (P3-01; D-154, D-155, D-161, D-162, D-163). The server (words.py) and the app (frontend/src/words.js) both read this file. Simple is everyone's default view; Advanced keeps the industry words. Display only: stored values, Desk, record numbers and folder names do not change. A state missing from `states` shows as stored.
_portal_comment: A client makes no decision in the portal (D-134), so its Simple words never suggest one is owed (D-165): these replace the D-162 words in the client portal only.
_notices_comment: The staff bell's sentences (P3-06, D-175), built when the bell is read, in the reader's mode, with the staff words above (never portal_states). A user's text is only ever a value ({actor}, {title}); the sentence is always this file's. Simple hides the notices of advanced_sections, which Mark all as read leaves unread for Advanced.
